edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against owner in the onlyOwner modifier guarding transferOwnership.

addAdmin is protected by onlyOwner, i.e. msg.sender == owner.
removeAdmin is protected by onlyOwner, i.e. msg.sender == owner.
setERC721, which controls the delegatecall target, is protected only by the onlyAdmin modifier evaluated on msg.sender.
setTokenURI authorizes the write solely by ownerOf(tokenId) == msg.sender.
